faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Professional Video Editor post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Professional Video Editor position at IIT Madras is 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree in Visual Communication, Multimedia, Animation, Film Editing, Digital Media, Mass Communication, or a related field, along with relevant experience and software proficiency.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the IIT Madras Professional Video Editor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Professional Video Editor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 45,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Professional Video Editor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Professional Video Editor post at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online through the official IIT Madras website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Professional Video Editor role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves online application, shortlisting, a test/interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Madras offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details for this particular post.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for the Professional Video Editor position?
faq.answer: Candidates are expected to have 1 to 3 years of experience in video editing and related fields.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
